scripts/check_architecture.sh.name: Inward dependency checks
scripts/check_architecture.sh.description: Checks workspace dependency direction and keeps vendor-specific rules out of shared generation code.

scripts/check_contract_mutations.sh.name: Deliberate regression gate
scripts/check_contract_mutations.sh.description: Runs registered intentional regressions in an isolated source copy and requires genuine behavioral test failures.

scripts/check_contracts.sh.name: Shared completion gate
scripts/check_contracts.sh.description: Checks required regressions, workspace tests, doctests, architecture and both mutation gates.

scripts/check_domain_mutations.sh.name: Domain mutation gate
scripts/check_domain_mutations.sh.description: Runs pinned mutation tools against adventure rules and only their own tests.

scripts/check_test_tools.sh.name: Pinned test tool checks
scripts/check_test_tools.sh.description: Rejects incompatible cargo-mutants and cargo-nextest versions before the shared gates run.

scripts/lib/test_outcome.sh.name: Targeted test outcome reading
scripts/lib/test_outcome.sh.description: Distinguishes genuine assertion failures from missing tests, compiler failures and other invalid outcomes.

scripts/test_mutation_outcome.sh.name: Mutation result reader tests
scripts/test_mutation_outcome.sh.description: Checks that test-result parsing rejects invalid evidence instead of counting it as a detected regression.
